title: Male Reproductive Health of Floating Population: a Large-Scale Survey in Dongguan
brief_summary: To determine the prevalence of sexual problems particularly premature ejaculation and erectile dysfunction among men working in factories of Dongguan city, using the self-rating scales like International Index of Erectile Function, and to investigate the characteristics or risk factors associated with these sexual problems in floating population through regression analysis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* have reached 18 years old
* live in Dongguan more than 6 months
* floating population
* with or without residence card

Exclusion Criteria:

* younger than 18 years old
* live in Dongguan less than 6 months
study_population: male workers in several towns of Dongguan city
